messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "for adults and pediatric patients (10 years and older) with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia"
set: ["for adults and pediatric patients (10 years and older) with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia", "LDL-C in adults and pediatric patients (10 years and older) with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)", "adults and pediatric patients with type 1 diabetes", "pediatric patients 12 years and older with depression", "adult and pediatric patients", "children 7 years of age and older with high blood cholesterol due to homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HoFH)", "children with homozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: 20 mg once daily for those 7 years of age and older", "adults and children 3 years and older", "rhinitis (adults and children 12 years of age and older)", "adults with high blood cholesterol due to heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)", "patients with obesity aged 12 years and older", "children 8 years of age and older with high blood cholesterol due to heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)", "for ADHD in pediatric patients", "pediatric patients less than 6 years old", "oral administration recommended for patients 12 years and older", "pediatric patients younger than 6 years with type 1 diabetes"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
